hook.text: A driver opens your car trunk remotely, places a package inside, and locks it. You're miles away at work.

buildup.text: In-vehicle delivery uses smart car connectivity to deliver packages directly to a customer's parked car.

discovery.text: The driver gets a one-time digital key. GPS confirms the right car. Cameras record the delivery.

twist.text: Most customers are uncomfortable letting strangers access their car. Trust is the biggest adoption barrier.

climax.text: Amazon Key to Car works with select vehicles. Volvo and GM offer similar services in partnerships.

punchline.text: Your car is always parked somewhere. That makes it a locker.

quiz.question: What is the biggest barrier to in-vehicle delivery adoption?
